name: Multivariate Transfer Function Combination Selection
definition: A method to select which dataset properties form the 2D transfer function domain and which serve as 1D tertiary attributes, balancing dimensionality and usability by scoring remaining properties based on correlation and entropy.
summary: Multivariate Transfer Function Combination Selection is a preprocessing method that automates attribute selection for volume rendering using a quantitative correlation-entropy scoring vector to balance property independence and information content.
